verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Lever's AI interview guide generator, which produces interview questions in minutes. That glancingly touches the question-bank part of the story. Nothing shows those questions are attached to a role-level interview plan with defined stages, assigned to individual interviewers with focus areas, or reused across requisitions. Missing for 10: per-role interview plan configuration, stage definitions within the plan, reusable question banks tied to roles, per-interviewer focus-area assignments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
